name: approval-gate
description: The ticket 15.2 human-in-the-loop demonstration: an offline `llm` draft feeds a `human_approval` gate that parks the run's branch without holding a lease or worker slot (ADR-017), and a `publish` step consumes the approved payload. The gate carries an `edit_schema` (so an approver may supply a bounded edited payload), a `timeout` with an `on_timeout` policy (the delayed-queue expiry is wired in 15.4), and the default `on_reject: fail` routing. Running it on the mock provider stops at `approve_publish` in `awaiting_human` while the fleet keeps executing other runs; the decision API (15.3) resumes it. `publish` reads `${{ steps.approve_publish.output.payload }}` — the approved value, which the decision (15.3) makes the step's output — so the gate is transparent to the rest of the graph.
